stories.title: Maharashtra tops passenger and commercial vehicle sales, UP leads two- and three-wheelers in Q2: SIAM - ET Auto
Western states drive car sales in Q2, Maharashtra leads
stories.summary: Maharashtra remains India's largest passenger vehicle market, selling 1.6 lakh units in the second quarter of fiscal 2027. While the western region retained its lead among national sales zones, its market share slipped from 33 percent to 32 percent. Growth is apparently not a regional monopoly.

stories.title: Western states lead vehicle sales in July-September quarter: Siam
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle sales in India reached 1.361 million units during the second quarter of fiscal 2027, according to the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers. Maharashtra accounted for 165,000 of those units. The state continues to hold the largest share of the national passenger vehicle market.

stories.title: Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh dominate auto sales in July-Sep: SIAM
stories.summary: Maharashtra emerged as the largest market for passenger and commercial vehicles during the second quarter of fiscal 2027, while Uttar Pradesh led sales of two-wheelers and three-wheelers. Data from the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers shows national passenger vehicle sales reached 13.61 lakh units for the period.

stories.title: Maharashtra Tops India's Passenger Vehicle, CV Sales In Q2 FY27, UP Tops Two-Wheeler, Three-Wheeler Markets - ACKO Drive
India: Automobile sales grow across major segments in 10MCY'26 as demand momentum extends beyond festive season - BigMin
Piyush Goyal Co-Chairs 23rd India-Italy JCEC with a Focus on the Auto Industry - ACKO Drive
Japanese carmakers face criticism over EV transition
stories.summary: Professor Jhunjhunwala has criticised Japanese automakers in India for their slow adoption of electric vehicles. While stating that the technology is available and economically viable, he suggested that the companies are dragging their feet. The industry is currently waiting for a change in management approach.

stories.title: Ambani, Mittal Could Turbocharge India’s Space Ambitions - Bloomberg.com
Volkswagen to launch Virtus facelift on December 11
stories.summary: Volkswagen has confirmed a December 11 launch for the updated Virtus sedan. In typical fashion, the company is focusing on subtle tweaks rather than a full overhaul. The changes are expected to mirror the recent updates seen on the Skoda Slavia facelift.

stories.title: Kia Carens and Clavis CNG cross 6000 unit mark
stories.summary: Kia has sold over 6200 units of its Carens and Clavis CNG models since their September launch. The company says this reflects customer acceptance of its factory-fitted CNG offerings. Kia also offers an assured residual value of up to 75 percent after three years for these vehicles.

stories.title: Kia Sorento Crosses 4,500 Wholesale Units in India Since Launch - ACKO Drive
JSW Combat SUV Revealed to Components From 50+ Global Brands - India Car News
JSW Combat revealed during commercial shoot
stories.summary: JSW Motors will enter the independent automotive market on December 4 with the launch of its first model, the JSW Combat. The premium plug-in hybrid SUV was recently spotted without camouflage during a television commercial shoot. It bears a visual resemblance to the overseas Jetour T2.

stories.title: Hyundai tests new hybrid SUV in Korea
stories.summary: Hyundai is testing a new hybrid SUV in Korea, reported to be the Ni1i model developed for the Indian market. Expected to compete in the premium 7-seater category, the vehicle will be positioned between the Alcazar and the Palisade. It was spotted riding on 18-inch JK Tyres.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki to launch three new cars by 2027
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki plans to introduce a micro SUV, a 3-row SUV, and an electric MPV by 2027. The company aims to bolster its presence in the SUV and electric segments. Its entry-level Y43 micro SUV is currently undergoing road tests.

stories.title: Hyundai Verna achieves 5-star BNCAP rating
stories.summary: The Hyundai Verna has secured a five-star Bharat NCAP crash test rating, scoring 28.22 out of 32 for adult occupant protection. The rating applies to the entire range, which includes two 1.5-litre engine options. The vehicle was tested at a weight of 1.52 tonnes.

stories.title: Tata Sierra EV scores 5 stars in Bharat NCAP crash test
stories.summary: The Tata Sierra EV has received a five-star Bharat NCAP rating, with an adult occupant protection score of 30.62 out of 32. The result covers the entire range, including both 63kWh and 75kWh battery variants. The vehicle achieved a perfect score in the side movable barrier test.

stories.title: Rumour: Renault India's upcoming SUV powertrain plans revealed - Team-BHP
3 New Luxury Car Brands Coming to India in 2027 - India Car News
BMW to launch Alpina in India in 2027
stories.summary: BMW plans to introduce its luxury Alpina brand to India in 2027, targeting high-income consumers across 10 cities. The company aims to strengthen its premium market position and close the gap with Mercedes-Benz, which currently leads luxury car sales in the country. Recruitment for the expansion is underway.

stories.title: Royal Enfield plans 250cc bikes to tap rising demand from young upgraders - ET Auto
Royal Enfield's Flying Flea enters Kochi, opens five sales and service centres - ET Auto
Royal Enfield Flying Flea C6 enters Kochi, expands to fifth city in India - HT Auto
TVS discontinues Star City Plus
stories.summary: TVS has pulled the Star City Plus from its lineup after more than a decade. The 110cc commuter, which featured an 8.2hp engine, was last updated over five years ago. The company continues to sell its Radeon and Sport models on the same platform.

stories.title: India two-wheeler sales rise 16 percent in October
stories.summary: India's two-wheeler manufacturers dispatched 2,577,810 units in October 2026, a 16.1 percent increase year-on-year. Hero MotoCorp maintained its lead in wholesale volumes, though the industry report noted a contrast between these factory dispatches and actual retail registrations recorded by FADA.

stories.title: Electric two-wheeler dispatches surge 93 percent
stories.summary: Electric two-wheeler wholesale dispatches reached 224,413 units in October 2026, up from 116,355 units in October 2025. Bajaj Chetak emerged as the best-selling model, followed by the TVS iQube. Hero Vida more than doubled its dispatches, while new models from Ather and TVS also contributed to the growth.

stories.title: Scooter market grows 31 percent in October
stories.summary: Domestic scooter dispatches reached 1,096,756 units in October 2026, a 31.6 percent increase compared to the previous year. The Honda Activa remained the best-selling scooter, while the Bajaj Chetak, TVS iQube and Hero Vida secured spots among the top 10 as electric models gained market share.

stories.title: TVS removes Star City Plus from website
stories.summary: TVS Motor has removed the Star City Plus from its official Indian website, suggesting the commuter motorcycle has been discontinued due to low demand. The model competed in the 110cc segment, where it struggled against rivals from Hero, Honda and Bajaj.

stories.title: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility wins Earthshot Prize 2026 for electric vehicle push - ET Auto
Mahindra Last Mile Mobility wins Earthshot Prize
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited has won the 2026 Earthshot Prize in the Clean Our Air category. Founded by Prince William, the prize includes a £1 million grant. The company reports it has sold over 400,000 electric commercial vehicles in India to date.

stories.title: Mahindra electric vehicles receive Earthshot recognition
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited received the 2026 Earthshot Prize for its electric commercial vehicles. The company claims its fleet of 400,000 vehicles has travelled over 9 billion kilometres and avoided approximately 185,000 metric tonnes of CO2 emissions. The award honours efforts to expand sustainable mobility for small businesses.

stories.title: Mahindra wins Earthshot Prize for electric mobility
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited won the 2026 Earthshot Prize at a ceremony in Mumbai. The award, which comes with a £1 million grant, recognises the company's work in electric last-mile transportation. The prize was founded by Prince William to support solutions for global environmental challenges.

stories.title: US-based ride-hailing giant Uber and Mahindra Last Mile Mobility have teamed up to expand electric mobility in India, wi
India EV charging infrastructure faces reliability hurdles
stories.summary: India had 52,718 public EV charging stations registered by July 2026, with the government approving ₹851 crore for 8,147 chargers. Despite rapid expansion, operators face ongoing challenges with charger reliability, payment failures and profitability. The market remains crowded with 12 major competing networks.

stories.title: Ather's stock surge revives investor interest in India's electric two-wheeler startups - ET Auto
Electric vehicle range claims versus reality
stories.summary: Customers often worry about real-world range when planning long highway trips in electric vehicles. While manufacturers provide official estimates, actual performance varies based on driving style, speed, traffic, weather, and road conditions. Several Indian models now claim to exceed 400km under normal conditions.

stories.title: Ola Electric drops out of top 16 sales list
stories.summary: Ola Electric failed to place any models in the top 16 list for October, with the 16th spot held by the Honda Activa E at 172 units. Bajaj Chetak led the market with 64,134 units, followed by TVS iQube. The company has lost its top position.

stories.title: Carens EV launches in Indonesia
stories.summary: Kia has launched the Carens EV in Indonesia, positioning the vehicle as a stylish, SUV-inspired electric MPV for families. The model is intended to expand the company's footprint in the Indonesian market.

stories.title: Hyundai Neira pre-bookings to open in Indonesia
stories.summary: Hyundai will open pre-bookings for its locally manufactured Neira electric MPV on November 20 at GAIKINDO Auto Week. The seven-seat vehicle is based on the Kia Carens Clavis. Battery capacity, driving range, and pricing details remain unannounced.

stories.title: Hyundai reveals production-ready Neira electric MPV
stories.summary: Hyundai has unveiled the production-specification Neira electric MPV ahead of its public showcase in Indonesia. The vehicle shares its design and underpinnings with the Kia Carens Clavis EV. The model highlights the group's strategy of sharing products across its portfolio.

stories.title: Delhivery to deploy 2,000 electric commercial vehicles
stories.summary: Logistics firm Delhivery has partnered with Tata Motors, Euler Motors, and Montra Electric to add up to 2,000 electric commercial vehicles to its fleet. The move aims to integrate electric transport into the company's existing logistics operations.

stories.title: Tata Motors expands global CV network, launches operations in Syria - The Hawk
Tata Motors expands commercial vehicle sales to Syria
stories.summary: Tata Motors has partnered with Ghassan Aboud Automotive to distribute its commercial vehicle range in Syria. The collaboration aims to provide cargo and mass mobility solutions to the region, with the distributor noting the vehicles are well-suited for local market needs.

stories.title: Hyundai expects electric Staria Load to capture 20 percent of sales
stories.summary: Hyundai expects its new Staria Load Electric to account for up to 20 percent of the model's total sales. Executives identified government and corporate fleets as primary targets for the vehicle, which offers an electric alternative to existing diesel and hybrid variants.

stories.title: Hyundai Motor to equip next-gen Porter truck with Pleos software - mkbn.mk.co.kr
M&H Carriers adds 18 Mercedes-Benz eSprinters to fleet
stories.summary: M&H Carriers has expanded its electric fleet with the acquisition of 18 new Mercedes-Benz eSprinter vans. The company continues to integrate electric vehicles into its logistics operations.

stories.title: Lilongwe plans 150 electric buses and local manufacturing
stories.summary: Lilongwe has announced a deal to acquire 150 electric buses and establish local electric vehicle manufacturing. The initiative aims to modernize the city's public transport infrastructure through a new partnership.

stories.title: Owl survives 70-mile journey trapped in truck
stories.summary: A great horned owl survived being struck by a tractor-trailer travelling at 65 mph. The bird remained trapped in the vehicle's front air dam for approximately 70 miles before rescuers in Pennsylvania freed it. The owl sustained few injuries during the trip.

stories.title: Fatal SUV collision on Zirakpur flyover
stories.summary: A 48-year-old man died and two others were injured after their SUV collided with a tractor-trailer on the Zirakpur flyover early Wednesday. The police have taken the tractor-trailer driver into custody and are investigating the incident.

stories.title: Three youths killed in highway collision
stories.summary: Three youths died and one was critically injured when their autorickshaw collided with a truck and a tractor on NH-31 in Katihar district on Wednesday. The victims were returning home after attending a local event.

stories.title: Biker killed in collision with parked tractor-trolley
stories.summary: A motorcyclist was killed and another seriously injured after their bike struck a tractor-trolley parked on the Jalandhar-Pathankot National Highway on Tuesday night. Local villagers expressed resentment following the accident.

stories.title: Auto component makers face margin pressure
stories.summary: Indian auto component makers reported 24.7 percent revenue growth in the first half of fiscal year 2027. However, profitability growth slowed as aggregate EBITDA margins contracted to 11.4 percent, driven by tyre-related margin pressure, rising working capital, and higher debt levels.

stories.title: Talbros-Lohum JV gets Apollo Tyres and MRF product approval
stories.summary: The joint venture between Talbros Automotive Components and Lohum has received product sample approval from Apollo Tyres and MRF for its recycled carbon black business. The manufacturers are now evaluating the final product, with the approval process expected to conclude within four weeks. Commercial production targets mid-FY28.

stories.title: Michelin India opens new retail store in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
stories.summary: Michelin India has opened a new 11,000 sq ft tyre and services store in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, in partnership with Chouhan Tyres. The facility offers the company's passenger vehicle tyre portfolio and maintenance services. This expansion brings the company's nationwide retail network to more than 800 points of sale.

stories.title: Hanon Systems pitches thermal management tech to Indian automakers
stories.summary: South Korea's Hanon Systems is expanding its local business in India by pitching thermal management technologies for electric and hybrid vehicles to Mahindra and Maruti Suzuki. The company aims to move beyond internal combustion engine components to capture a larger share of the country's electrification supply chain.

stories.title: Iron Force Industrial shifts global production
stories.summary: Automotive parts maker Iron Force Industrial is expanding its global production footprint. The company cites weak demand in China and the impact of US tariffs as factors currently weighing on its product mix and overall earnings.

stories.title: AM/NS India to commission automotive steel complex in Gujarat
stories.summary: ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India has invested ₹9,000 crore in an automotive steel complex at Hazira, Gujarat, as part of a larger ₹60,000 crore expansion plan. The facility is set to be commissioned within weeks, aiming to produce advanced steel grades and reduce domestic reliance on imports.

stories.title: Why One Wire Compound No Longer Fits All Vehicles - PlasticsToday
Heshun combines tube bending and end forming for chassis production
stories.summary: Heshun has introduced a configurable production line that integrates automotive tube bending and end forming into a single route. The system manages the process from feeding to the finished component, aiming to preserve necessary datums and assembly dimensions while coordinating operations around specific chassis tubes.

stories.title: DRIVNIX details suspension brake systems for luxury brands
stories.summary: DRIVNIX operates a 20,000-square-meter facility providing OEM and ODM capabilities for luxury and electric vehicle brands, including Bentley, Ferrari, and Tesla. The manufacturer maintains a standardized database for part matching and implements a dual-review process to ensure precision in its suspension and brake system components.

stories.title: Sintered brake pads market projected to grow through 2035
stories.summary: The global automotive sintered brake pads market is entering a phase of structural expansion, with demand expected to accelerate through 2035. Driven by EV thermal loads, the market is seeing more disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture for these high-temperature, performance-critical components.

stories.title: JSW Motors to establish independent dealership network
stories.summary: JSW Motors is launching an independent dealership network for its entry into the Indian passenger vehicle market, opting not to share infrastructure with JSW MG Motor India. The company plans to have 50 outlets operational by early 2027, eventually expanding to at least 100 touch points.

stories.title: Brownsville commission approves CarMax dealership
stories.summary: The City Commission of Brownsville, Texas, has given initial approval to a proposed 4.5-acre CarMax dealership along Stillman Road. The project is one step closer to development following the commission's recent vote.

stories.title: Car buyer walks away after dealer adds $4,000 fee
stories.summary: A New Jersey shopper reported walking away from a vehicle purchase after a dealer allegedly increased the price from an emailed $24,600 to $49,000. The buyer stated it took three hours to receive a breakdown of the costs, which included a $4,000 dealer fee.

stories.title: Biggest car dealer in southern Iowa
stories.summary: WHO 13 News reported on the operations of the largest car dealer in southern Iowa. The segment highlighted the scale of the dealership's presence in the region.

stories.title: Dealer certificate suspended for early Ferrari delivery
stories.summary: The Maharashtra transport department has suspended the trade certificate of a Navnit Motors outlet in Mumbai for 30 days. The action follows the delivery of a Ferrari to a customer before the vehicle's registration was complete, which violated regional transport office rules regarding high-security registration plates.

stories.title: Georgia automotive group acquires Dreyer & Reinbold dealerships in Indianapolis, Greenwood - WTHR
Dreyer and Reinbold sells dealerships to Five Star Automotive
stories.summary: Dreyer and Reinbold has sold seven of its local dealerships to Georgia-based Five Star Automotive. The transaction involves the transfer of multiple locations within the Indianapolis area.

stories.title: Auto stocks rally as Nifty Auto index climbs
stories.summary: Shares of Maruti Suzuki, Mahindra and Mahindra, Tata Motors, and Eicher Motors rose on Thursday, leading the Nifty Auto index to a 2.6 percent gain. The rally in automobile stocks followed a recent decline in global crude oil prices.

stories.title: Auto stocks rally on expectations of improved performance
stories.summary: The Nifty Auto index rose 2.6 percent to 28,111.95 on Thursday, outperforming the broader Nifty 50 index. Investors are showing demand for automobile stocks amid expectations that falling commodity prices will improve the operational performance of companies in the sector.

stories.title: Auto stocks rally as sector sentiment improves
stories.summary: Auto sector stocks traded higher on Thursday, with Maruti Suzuki, Tata Motors and Mahindra and Mahindra among the leading gainers. The Nifty Auto index climbed over 4 percent, outperforming the broader Nifty 50. The rally followed a decline in international crude oil prices.

stories.title: Nifty Auto index climbs 4 percent
stories.summary: The Nifty Auto index rose over 4 percent on Thursday, supported by expectations of lower input costs and improving demand. Maruti Suzuki led the rally with a 5 percent gain. The index outperformed the Nifty 50, which rose 0.53 percent amid a global supply surplus in crude oil.

stories.title: Public-sector banks report record half-yearly profit
stories.summary: India's public-sector banks posted a record net profit of 1.10 trillion rupees in the first half of fiscal year 2027, a 17 percent year-on-year increase. The finance ministry attributed the performance to stronger balance sheets and robust credit growth. Retail and farm loans saw double-digit growth.

stories.title: SpiceJet seeks funds exceeding total debt
stories.summary: SpiceJet plans to raise 5,500 crore rupees through share sales or loans, an amount higher than its 4,218.5 crore rupees of total reported debt. The airline, which holds a 0.6 percent market share, did not disclose potential investors. The fundraising is intended to rebuild the airline.

stories.title: CRIF reports growth in small-ticket retail lending
stories.summary: India's retail lending book grew to 185.2 lakh crore rupees in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Consumer durable, personal and two-wheeler loans accounted for nearly half of new-to-credit accounts. The report suggests periodic monitoring of credit scores to manage debt levels.

stories.title: Small-ticket loan defaults rise alongside growth
stories.summary: India's retail lending book grew 18.8 percent year-on-year to 185.2 lakh crore rupees in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. While small-ticket loans help finance everyday spending, rising defaults in the segment underscore the need for borrowers to manage their debt.

stories.title: NaBFID to enter wholesale securitization market
stories.summary: The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development plans to participate in the wholesale asset-backed securities market next year. The state-run lender aims to gain a foothold in the sector after India's securitization volume reached a record 1.47 trillion rupees in the first half of the year.

stories.title: Report says FCNR deposit impact on banks remains incomplete
stories.summary: Foreign Currency Non-Resident deposits continue to influence the performance of Indian banks, according to an ICICI Bank report. The analysis suggests that the full impact of these deposits on funding costs and earnings has yet to accrue, potentially affecting future banking stock performance.

stories.title: Sonatus launches plug-in AI gateway for vehicle testing - Automotive World
Siloed thinking cited as barrier to software-defined vehicles
stories.summary: Prof. Eric Sax of the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology says commercial and competition-related restrictions are hindering collaboration between automakers. He argues that manufacturers must retain responsibility for integrating software and vehicle systems to effectively develop software-defined vehicles. Collaboration remains a challenge.

stories.title: Smart chassis market projected to grow by 2030
stories.summary: The Gasgoo Automotive Research Institute expects smart suspension penetration to exceed 40 percent by 2030. The sector is undergoing value reshaping driven by x-by-wire technologies and cross-domain integration. The total market size for these intelligent chassis components is estimated to top 100 billion yuan.

stories.title: Connected two-wheeler telematics market expands
stories.summary: The global installed base of active telematics systems in motorcycles and scooters is forecast to exceed 85 million units by 2030, according to Berg Insight. The expansion is driven by electric two-wheeler growth and demand for embedded IoT connectivity for safety and security services.

stories.title: Motorbike telematics systems forecast to triple
stories.summary: The number of active OEM telematics systems in motorcycles and scooters is expected to rise from 19.7 million in 2025 to 62.6 million by 2030. Analysts cite safety and stolen vehicle tracking as primary drivers for the adoption of embedded connectivity in two-wheelers.

stories.title: ePlane to use Lynx software platform for mixed-criticality computing on e200X eVTOL - ET Auto
Pony.ai robotaxi and robotruck revenues surge in Q3 - Automotive World
Einride grows contracted revenue 76% as autonomy expands - Automotive World
Nexteer receives mobility innovation awards
stories.summary: Nexteer Automotive has been recognized with three awards for its High Mount Direct Drive Steer-by-Wire Hand-Wheel Actuator. The technology, introduced in August 2026, is designed to enable cockpit design flexibility and steering feel for software-defined vehicles. The company received honors from CES and Automotive News.

stories.title: NHAI tests toll plaza insurance checks
stories.summary: The National Highways Authority of India is piloting a system at the Mundka toll plaza to identify vehicles without valid insurance. Owners may receive SMS notifications for violations, with potential fines of 10,000 rupees. The system aims to automate the detection of uninsured vehicles.

stories.title: Heavy industries ministry rejects insurance bonds for battery projects
stories.summary: The ministry of heavy industries has rejected a proposal to allow insurance surety bonds instead of bank guarantees for its production-linked incentive scheme for batteries. The move follows failed efforts to build domestic cell manufacturing capacity. The ministry has now shortlisted 22 bidders for the latest tender.

stories.title: International flights to face new fuel blending requirements
stories.summary: Airlines operating international flights from India must use a fuel blend containing 1% sustainable aviation fuel starting in 2027. The fuel costs up to three times more than conventional jet fuel. Airlines are currently asking the government who will cover the price difference.

stories.title: Meta seeks new India policy chief to mend government relations
stories.summary: Meta is scouting for a vice president of public policy in India to address its fractured relationship with the government. The company aims to secure its growth in its largest market by user count. The new executive will oversee government relations, currently led by a senior director.

stories.title: Revenue department to recruit 3,310 staff for land survey
stories.summary: The revenue and land reforms department will recruit 3,310 personnel by February 2027 to expedite an ongoing land survey in Bihar. The drive follows a directive from the chief minister to complete the work within a set timeframe. Recruitment notifications are expected within days.

stories.title: Rachna Patil appointed as secretary to the governor
stories.summary: IAS officer Rachna Patil has assumed the role of secretary to governor Syed Ata Hasnain. The appointment follows the transfer of the governor's additional chief secretary amid ongoing university vice-chancellor appointments. The move coincides with a controversy regarding special leave granted to a state minister for a teaching position.

stories.title: India accuses Pakistan military of exploiting mineral wealth
stories.summary: India has accused Pakistan's military establishment of exploiting natural resources for personal enrichment at a UN Security Council meeting. Ambassador Parvathaneni Harish cited an incident involving Army Chief Asim Munir as evidence of the military's involvement in the country's mineral wealth. The military has not commented.

stories.title: Formula 1 partners with WHOOP for driver performance data
stories.summary: Formula 1 has announced a four-year partnership with wearable technology company WHOOP. The collaboration will integrate physiological monitoring into global broadcasts to show the physical and mental demands placed on drivers. The technology is the first consumer wearable approved by the FIA for use during races.

stories.title: WHOOP and Formula 1 Partner to Reveal the Human… | UNI India
stories.summary: Performance Behind the Wheel WHOOP, the human performance brand, today announced a four-year global partnership with Formula 1, becoming the Official Health & Fitness Wearable Partner of Formula 1 and the first consumer wearable approved by the FIA for in-race use. Beginning in 2027, the partnership will bring continuous physiological

stories.title: Tommy Hilfiger partners with Cadillac Formula 1 team
stories.summary: Tommy Hilfiger is returning to motorsport through a collaboration with the Cadillac Formula 1 team. The partnership combines the fashion house's design language with the visual identity of the new racing team. The brand previously maintained a long-standing relationship with the sport.

stories.title: Las Vegas Grand Prix marks final phase of 2026 season
stories.summary: The 2026 Formula 1 season concludes with the Las Vegas Grand Prix on November 19 to 21. With Kimi Antonelli already confirmed as the drivers' champion and Mercedes as the constructors' champion, teams are now focused on securing second and third place in the standings.

stories.title: Atiqa Mir secures podium in karting season finale
stories.summary: Indian racer Atiqa Mir finished third in the final round of the Champions of the Future Academy karting series. The rookie season performance included a fastest lap in the final race. Mir is the first Indian driver to achieve a podium finish in the series.

stories.title: JLR and Norton to join Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2027
stories.summary: The third Bharat Mobility Global Expo will take place in New Delhi from February 4 to 9, 2027. Organizers confirmed 44 vehicle manufacturers, including Jaguar Land Rover and Norton Motorcycles, will participate. Officials expect the event to be the largest motor show held by the society to date.

stories.title: FEATURE: Climate resilience - Electric & Hybrid Vehicle Technology International
'Stand firm': CCC warns UK likely to miss climate targets if EV targets are weakened - BusinessGreen
Climate advisers warn against weakening electric vehicle targets
stories.summary: The Climate Change Committee has urged the government to maintain current zero-emission vehicle targets for new cars. Advisers warned that weakening the policy could risk climate goals and undermine automotive investment. The Department for Transport is currently reviewing the mandate following industry pressure to soften annual sales targets.

stories.title: Why cutting electric vehicle targets could put the UK's climate goals at risk
stories.summary: Highlights - Climate advisers warn that weakening the Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) Mandate would put legally binding climate targets at risk. - Government assessment suggests changes could increase annual oil consumption by 15 million barrels by 2030. - Ministers are reviewing the rules following a consultation that closed on October 23.

stories.title: Climate committee warns of costs from EV target changes
stories.summary: The Climate Change Committee warned that relaxing electric vehicle sales targets could increase household costs and fossil fuel dependence. Advisers stated that switching to an electric car could save households 800 pounds annually. Ministers are currently considering changes to the rules following pressure from the automotive industry.

stories.title: Liberal Democrats criticize shifting electric vehicle policy
stories.summary: Liberal Democrat transport spokesperson Olly Glover stated that the government risks missing climate targets if it waters down electric vehicle requirements. The party argued that drivers are deterred by patchy charging infrastructure and shifting policy landscapes rather than overly ambitious targets. The government is currently reviewing its mandate.

stories.title: Pakistan external debt reaches 135 billion dollars
stories.summary: The World Bank International Debt Report 2026 shows Pakistan external debt reached 135.1 billion dollars in 2025, a 97 percent increase from 2015. Despite economic struggles and substantial dependence on foreign financing, international institutions and governments continue to provide the country with new loans.

Britain’s auto industry caught between EU rules and Chinese investment - Automotive News
Nissan unveils two China-built plug-in hybrids, eyes exports to 30 markets, as China recovery plan ramps up - Automotive
BYD exports rise as domestic sales contract
stories.summary: BYD shipped 1,513,154 new energy vehicles overseas through October 2026, a 93.75 percent increase. The growth offset a 27.81 percent decline in Chinese domestic deliveries. Global sales for the period fell 2.16 percent to 3,621,744 units. The company is currently building vehicles faster than the market is buying them.

stories.title: Chinese suppliers capture 13 percent of global auto parts revenue
stories.summary: Chinese auto parts suppliers now hold 13 percent of global revenue, up from a negligible presence twenty years ago. The industry attributes this growth to scale, cost leadership, and a lead in new technologies like batteries and smart cockpits. The global automotive supply chain is shifting accordingly.

stories.title: Mazda delays first electric vehicle to 2029
stories.summary: Mazda is cutting its EV spending by nearly half and delaying its first true electric vehicle launch until 2029. The company is pivoting toward hybrid models like the CX-50 and CX-5. Mazda has been slower than its peers to electrify, which the company now views as a strategic advantage.

GM is betting faster development and profitable EVs will blunt regulatory swings from elections - Automotive News
Toyota Tsusho bets on Chinese chips with new software unit - Automotive World

research.title: Cross-Vehicle Transferability of Lateral Velocity Estimation on Production Vehicles through Input Selection and Data Augmentation
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Lateral velocity is safety-critical for vehicle-dynamics control but cannot be measured with production sensors. Model-based estimators such as Kalman filters are established, whereas data-driven estimators are more accurate within the training regime but suspected to lose. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Estimation-Aware Reachability

Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Keeping Shielded Data-Driven Controllers Safe Under System Evolution via Model Consistency
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Cyber-physical systems (CPS) increasingly contain data-driven controllers, which raise safety concerns given their black-box nature. A common mitigation is to enforce system safety via a shield around the controller, which restricts the inputs based on assumptions. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Learning and Control in Physically Coupled Dynamical Systems
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce TAG (Testbed for Autonomous Games), a compact, low-cost robotic platform for studying learning and control in physically coupled dynamical systems. TAG combines an actively tilted and steered ball-in-maze board with a top-mounted rotary inverted. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Mitigating the Grid Impact of Gigawatt-Scale AI Data Centers via High-Fidelity Model Flexibility
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Gigawatt-scale artificial intelligence data centers (AIDCs) are being connected at a single point of interconnection (POI) faster than transmission can be reinforced, yet studies of their flexibility rely on DC power flow and simplified load envelopes. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
